mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances was most worthwhile. It showed why the kidneys need to take things back rather than just filter out waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable because the slots and pictures named where they belonged.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the filter lets useful glucose and water through along with waste; the recovery tube takes useful substances back afterward.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and goals gave each pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it connected another body system to the model. The filtering and recovery sequence made me curious about how the systems work together, though the slot-fitting was less engaging.
